verdict.rationale: Asking a cloud fleet platform with an on-device agent whether users can opt out of vendor telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question, so the axis applies. The pack's many 'telemetry' references describe robot data the customer deliberately ingests, and per-stream rate limiting (formant-docs-31) controls that ingestion, not vendor tracking. Nothing documents an opt-out from Formant's own usage tracking of the agent, SDK or web app; the 'where you choose, scoped research partnerships' line hints at opt-in data sharing but is too vague to credit.
